reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 15 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; explicitly checked round dark spectacles and the broad gray viewer-right temple, swept brown top hair, brows, clean-shaven face, suit/purple tie, collar, backing, note rows and right tab.

remaining_reasons: The source's small dark right-edge note tab is absent from the returned note's right edge, which shows only plain worn paper. Restore the original compact dark tab and its position/form without substituting a stain, tear, fold or different hardware.
entries.positive_observation: The prior eyewear/temple defects are corrected: the returned portrait has ROUND dark spectacles rather than heavy rectangular frames, and the broad viewer-right temple/side is visibly GRAY beneath the swept-up dark-brown top hair. Separate dark brows, short sideburns, a smooth clean-shaven chin and one serious closed mouth remain. The slight-left three-quarter pose, tight crop and original glasses/facial shadows remain. The dark navy suit, white pointed shirt collar and purple tie with a tiny light pattern remain without other decorations. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The cream note retains its two upper mark rows; beige paper stains are not treated as invented writing. The dark blue-gray photographic backplate and thin dark frame remain opaque. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring; the missing right-edge tab is the separate visible rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: The note glyphs and exact tiny tie pattern are unreadable at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. Round spectacles and the broad gray temple are clearly visible and retained. The rejection depends only on the clearly absent right-edge tab in native/enlarged comparisons, not on paper texture, tiny writing or alpha numbers.
